check: pin constraints (strap pin input-only, boot-log pin unused, ADC on ADC1)

check: netlist integrity (no node in two nets, every pin net present)

check: E-STOP is hardware: NC contact in series D7 -> SW1 -> DRV8874 SLEEP, D10 senses SLEEP
detail: Pressing the button or cutting either wire lets the carrier pull SLEEP low -> outputs Hi-Z (coast); the worm drive holds the door. Not a certified safety function (no redundancy/monitoring category) - it is a kid-friendly hard stop.

check: DRV8874 PMODE tied to GND (PH/EN latched on wake)
detail: Carrier leaves PMODE floating (= independent half-bridge); the plate ties it to GND

check: driver current limit ~2.0 A (R1 20 k VREF->GND with carrier 10 k pull-up to SLEEP = 3.3 V)
detail: VREF = 3.3 x 20k/(10k+20k) = 2.20 V; I_lim = VREF / (450 uA/A x 2.49 k = 1.121 V/A) = 1.96 A (<= 2.1 A carrier continuous)

check: current-sense voltage inside the ADC span at the limit
